props.gloss_en: the baraita: 'Hear, Israel, the Lord is our God, the Lord is One' -- this is the Shema of R' Yehuda HaNasi
Rav to R' Chiyya: I did not see Rebbi accept upon himself the kingdom of Heaven
R' Chiyya: son of nobles, when he passes his hands over his face he accepts upon himself the yoke of the kingdom of Heaven
R' Shimon beRabbi: he [Rebbi] goes back and completes it [the Shema]
Bar Kappara: he does not go back and complete it
Rebbi seeks out a lesson that contains [mention of] the Exodus from Egypt
[he seeks it out] in order to mention the Exodus in its time
Rav: one who said 'Hear, Israel ... the Lord is One' and was overcome by sleep has fulfilled [his obligation]
Rav Nachman to Daru his servant: for the first verse, trouble me; more than that, do not trouble me
Rav Yosef son of Rabba: for the first verse [my father] would trouble himself; more than that he would not
Rav Yosef: one lying on his back shall not recite the Shema
R' Yehoshua ben Levi curses whoever sleeps lying on his back
sleeping [on the back] when one leans [to the side] is fine
reciting [the Shema so], even though one leans, is forbidden
R' Yochanan would lean and recite

supports.gloss_en: בשלמא לדידי דאמינא אינו חוזר וגומרה, היינו דמהדר רבי אשמעתא דאית בה יציאת מצרים -- granted for me: since he does not complete the Shema, that is why he seeks out a lesson with the Exodus

objections.gloss_en: אלא לדידך דאמרת חוזר וגומרה, למה ליה לאהדורי? -- if Rebbi completes the Shema later, why does he seek out a lesson containing the Exodus?

answered_by.gloss_en: כדי להזכיר יציאת מצרים בזמנה -- in order to mention the Exodus in its time (= p_lehazkir_yetziat_mitzrayim_bizmana)

objections.gloss_en: מקרא הוא דלא ליקרי, הא מיגנא שפיר דמי? והא רבי יהושע בן לוי לייט אמאן דגני אפרקיד! -- Rav Yosef's wording implies sleeping on the back is fine, but R' Yehoshua ben Levi cursed it

answered_by.gloss_en: אמרי: מיגנא כי מצלי שפיר דמי, מקרא אף על גב דמצלי נמי אסור -- sleeping is fine when leaning; reciting is forbidden even when leaning (= p_miyegna_ki_matzlei_shapir, p_mikra_afilu_matzlei_asur)

objections.gloss_en: והא רבי יוחנן מצלי וקרי! -- but R' Yochanan would lean and recite

answered_by.gloss_en: שאני רבי יוחנן דבעל בשר הוה -- R' Yochanan is different, for he was corpulent
